forgot_password_spam_hint: Didn't get it? Check your spam folder, or ask an admin to send it.

language_save_first: You have unsaved changes. Save them before switching language.

rejected_same_thing: {by} just changed the same thing, so your "{label}" didn't go through.
undo_too_old: That was too long ago to undo.

segment_order_last: This is already the last segment

segment_order_playhead_outside: The playhead isn't in this segment

segment_order_delete_records: Deleting {segment} also deletes these and clears {count} reps{undoable}

records_run_through_empty: Every skill was skipped; there's nothing to save

segment_under_one_beat: Less than one beat is left after the first beat
